title: StarNote: Handwriting & PDF
description:
StarNote: Your Next-Gen Digital Note-Taking App
Tired of slow, limited note-taking apps that demand expensive monthly fees? StarNote Notebook is engineered for students and professionals. We deliver unparalleled, low-latency handwriting that truly mimics paper on Android tablets. The best part? StarNote offers a simple one-time purchase for lifetime access—NO expensive subscriptions ever!
⭐ Stop searching for a Goodnotes alternative, Notability alternative, or Notewise alternative. StarNote is the feature-rich digital notebook built to be the industry leader on Google Play!
---
We prioritize efficiency and powerful tools for serious note takers. StarNote’s features are designed to significantly boost your productivity:

🚀 Ultimate Handwriting & Infinite Canvas
- True Pen Feel: Proprietary Ink Engine delivers highly responsive, low-lag handwriting for your stylus pen. Experience the best digital writing on your tablet.
- Infinite Scroll: Say goodbye to page boundaries! Our infinite canvas provides limitless space for mind maps, detailed sketches, and extensive project notes.
- Versatile Toolkit: Multiple pen types (fountain, ballpoint, highlighter) with customizable colors and thickness to perfect your digital journaling.

✨ Pro-Level Creation & Page Management (Unmatched Features)
- Layered Design: Advanced note layers let you separate annotations, images, and text onto distinct layers, simplifying complex digital planning and design projects.
- Seamless Expansion: Revolutionary page extension lets you instantly expand your handwritten notes in any direction—ideal for long meeting notes or spontaneous ideas.
- Pro Layout: Use layers and infinite page space to easily create sophisticated electronic planners or complex academic papers.

📘 PDF Annotation & Study Toolkit
- Deep PDF Annotation: Import PDF documents, textbooks, or work reports. Easily highlight, markup, and add your handwritten notes and text boxes directly onto the file.
- Smart Organizer: Robust file management system: folders, tags, and powerful search to keep study notes and work documents perfectly sorted.
- Quick Capture: Instantly import content (web pages, images) for immediate annotation on your digital notepad.

💡 Smart Backup & Data Security
- Intelligent Layout: Automatic beautification of handwriting and correction of shapes makes your final notebook look polished and professional.
- Cloud Sync & Backup: Seamlessly sync all your handwritten notes across multiple devices with cloud backup (Google Drive integration). Your data is always safe.
- Export Ready: Export your digital notes in various formats like PDF, PNG, and JPEGs for easy sharing and printing.

💎 Value & Creativity Hub (Unbeatable Price & Assets)
- Lifetime Access: No Subscription Fees! Get lifetime access to all Pro features with a single, affordable payment, unlike expensive subscription apps.
- Rich Asset Center: Access a massive, ever-growing library of FREE templates, professional stickers, and digital paper to customize your electronic planners without limits.
---
StarNote is the digital organizer for every user:
- Students: Ideal for lecture notes, creating flashcards, and comprehensive PDF study annotations.
- Professionals: Essential for swift meeting minutes, project management, and rapid handwriting ideation.
- Creators: The perfect digital journal, sketchbook, and planner tool.

【Important Feedback Channel】
We value every user's suggestion. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for StarNote, please contact our dedicated team directly via the App: Settings ➡️ Help & Feedback. Your input drives us to be the best note-taking app on Android!
StarNote is the premier Goodnotes alternative, Notability alternative, and Notewise alternative on Google Play. It provides the professional features you need, without the expensive subscription model. Download now to experience the ultimate handwriting app designed for your success.

title: MyScript Notes (Nebo)
description:
Create stunning notes and professional documents effortlessly by hand, brainstorm ideas on an infinite canvas, and annotate PDFs seamlessly. Powered by the world's leading AI handwriting recognition technology, MyScript Notes offers a dynamic platform where handwriting, text, drawings, diagrams, and images seamlessly coexist on an expandable canvas. Enhance your note-taking experience with intuitive pen gestures, effortlessly converting handwriting and shapes into typed text and precise forms.

MyScript Notes understands every word you write in your choice of 66 languages, and works on mobile platforms — so you can access and search your notes from any compatible device.

Enjoy 4 powerful experiences in one app:

◼︎ Create unlimited notebooks and fixed-size pages for your daily notes.
◼︎ Take freeform notes on boards — the world's most advanced endless canvas.
◼︎ Handwrite responsive documents, adding math calculations and diagrams.
◼︎ Import existing files as PDFs, ready to annotate.

————————

DIGITAL HANDWRITING
• Write¹, type or dictate in the same page, sentence or even word.
• Accurately convert handwriting and math to typed text, and drawn diagrams to perfect shapes. Diagrams stay editable when pasted into PowerPoint!
• Write emoji and symbols with your pen.

EDIT WITH YOUR PEN
• Use intuitive gestures to edit and format content without breaking your flow.
• Use the marker to highlight or color, the lasso to select, and the eraser to delete entire strokes or precisely defined content.

WRITE, TYPE AND DRAW FREELY ON A BOARD
• Enjoy an infinite canvas, ideal for brainstorming, mind mapping and freeform note-taking.
• Pan around and zoom in or out for a fresh perspective.
• Use the lasso to select, move, copy, delete or resize content — and to convert handwriting to typed text.

SWITCH TO A DOCUMENT FOR A RESPONSIVE EXPERIENCE
• Create and edit structured notes — your handwriting will automatically reflow as needed.
• Make edits, adjust layout, rotate your device or split your screen without worrying about readability.

ENRICH YOUR NOTES
• Personalize content using a range of pen types and page backgrounds.
• Add photos, sketches and smart objects like math and diagrams.
• Handwrite math equations and matrices across several lines, solve simple calculations and copy math as LaTeX or image.

————————

MyScript Notes respects your privacy and never stores content on our servers without your explicit consent.

For help or feature requests, create a ticket at https://myscri.pt/support
Check out MyScript Notes' webpage for more information about cross-platform: https://www.myscript.com/notes

————————

¹You can use any compatible active or passive pen, including Apple Pencil, to write in MyScript Notes. Check minimum and recommended requirements for MyScript Notes: https://myscri.pt/notes-devices

title: Jnotes: Note-Taking, AI, PDF
description:
Jnotes is the professional AI-powered PDF annotator and handwriting app. Seamlessly write on PDF, organize study notes, and use our digital planner to elevate your paperless productivity on tablets.

✨ Why Jnotes? The best Goodnotes alternative for Android users!

Looking for the ultimate note-taking app for your Android tablet? 📝 Jnotes offers smooth stylus writing, AI-powered notes, PDF annotation and editing tools, handwriting recognition (OCR), and rich note formats. Start creating smart, organized, and beautiful digital notes today!

✏️ Smooth Digital Handwriting
• Customizable pen colors and thickness.
• Advanced digital ink technology ensures lag-free handwriting with stylus support.
• Draw mind maps, write naturally, and enjoy refined stylus compatibility.
• Handwriting Recognition (OCR): Search, edit, and export handwritten content effortlessly.

🤖 AI-Powered Notes & Summary
• AI Summary: Quickly generate accurate summaries of your notes.
• AI Flashcards: Turn notes into interactive quizzes with AI highlighting key terms.
• AI Quizzes & Tests: Generate comprehensive quizzes (incl. single-select, multiple-choice, true/false, open-ended questions, case studies) for quick knowledge verification and gap identification.
• Multimodal AI Notes: Generate intelligent notes from documents (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, MD), media files (MP3, MP4, MOV), and images.

📄 PDF Annotation & Editing
• Import PDFs and annotate with a full toolkit.
• Add handwritten notes, comments, and highlights directly on PDFs.
• Multi-Window Support: Use multi-window reading and annotating.
• Convert, translate, copy-paste, and export PDFs easily.

🎨 Extensive Customization Options
• Switch between Dark Mode and Eye-Comfort Mode.
• Choose from various interface themes and styles for notebook personalization.
• Import custom fonts for unique, aesthetic notes.

📚 Rich Note Formats
• Vast Library: Tons of templates, covers, and stickers to make your notes pop.
• Powerful editing tools: stroke modification, auto-shape drawing, image insertion.
• Sync audio recordings with drawings and text for multimedia notes.

🗂️ Efficient Note Management
• Organize notes in multi-level folders.
• Quick search for typed or recognized handwritten content.
• Backup your notes locally for extra security.

Core Uses of Jnotes
 🎓 For Students
• Use Cornell Notes templates for structured study notes, college work, and test prep.
• Turn long notes into easy-to-review summaries with AI Summary.
• Automatically create interactive flashcards using AI.
• Annotate, highlight, and write directly on PDFs with ease.

💼 For Professionals
• Grab templates for meeting notes, business reports, and project management.
• Record voice notes during meetings and sync them with handwritten or typed text.
• OCR instantly converts handwriting into searchable, editable text.

🖊️ For Journaling & Planning
• Use Jnotes as a daily planner, personal journal, or creative notebook.
• Enjoy realistic, lag-free handwriting with stylus input.
• Plan everything—from meals to workouts—or sketch your next big idea.

📌 How to Get Help / Stay Connected

💬 Social Media:
- Instagram: @jnotesapp
- X: @Jnotes_official

description: DrawNote is a feature-rich all-in-one notebook & notepad that integrates note-taking, mind mapping, to-do list, handwriting, sketching, drawing and painting. Whether you're a student, teacher, artist, designer, engineer, or someone else, DrawNote offers powerful tools designed to spark your imagination and creativity. ⭐ Infinite Canvas - Create Infinite Possibilities • DrawNote has an infinite canvas, allowing your imagination and creativity to be fully utilized. • Using the flexible canvas, you can place text, pictures, recordings, tables, mind maps and other content arbitrarily. • You can sketch, draw and paint on the notepad and whiteboard with your finger or stylus. Writing, drawing diagrams and annotating content as freely as on paper. • Abundant stickers make your notes more lively and interesting. ⭐ Various note types • There are a variety of note types for notes, including Super Note, Text Note and Mind Mapping, to meet different usage scenarios. • Super Note combines handwriting, drawing, text, picture, table, mind map and other elements to fully express your creativity and artistic talent. • Text Note focus on text. Support rich text settings, such as color, thickness, size and margin, etc. • Mind Mapping help you quickly record ideas and organize knowledge. You can freely choose styles, borders, colors and styles. ⭐ Easily manage notes and share • Organize your work, study and personal life by managing your notes with unlimited folders. • You can sort notes by date, name, etc., and manually sort them. • Supports exporting notes in the notebook as high-quality pictures for easy sharing with others. • Use DrawNote as a notebook, journal or notepad. Access, organize and share your notes anytime, anywhere. ⭐ Efficiently manage to-do list • Create to-dos in DrawNote to make sure you never miss something important. • Set the priority and end time for the to-do items, and pin the to-do items to the system notification bar. • Use the notepad to manage your daily plans and tasks. ⭐ Data security and privacy protection • Cloud backup via Google Drive, turn on the auto backup option to ensure that your data will not be lost. • Set passwords for specific notes and folders to fully protect your privacy. ⭐ Other Features • DrawNote can be used as a digital whiteboard and notepad. The markup function helps you find important points and attract attention, which is very suitable for teaching and presentations. • Support dark mode and switch different theme colors according to personal preference and mood. • The user interface is simple and elegantly designed for ease of use. Of course, no ads. DrawNote is a super notebook & notepad. It is the first choice for you to record study notes, make teaching materials, conceive creative ideas, manage task lists, write literary works, record personal moods, and even pursue artistic creation. There are many more features waiting for you to discover! Download now to experience DrawNote APP and stimulate your creativity! Have a beautiful day!

description: Notes - Notepad, Notebook is a powerful and versatile note-taking app that helps you stay organized and productive. With a wide range of features and customization options, FlyNote is the perfect tool for students, professionals, and anyone else who needs to keep track of their thoughts and ideas. Try creating a new note, check list with FlyNote. You can create a new note/check list by tapping + in the bottom right corner of the main screen. Protect your notes and check list. 1. Click on the Note or check list you want to protect, then click on the lock icon in the upper right corner of the screen or click on more option and select the lock icon. Then create your password and answer the security question. 2. Lock the notes and check lists you want to protect by touching the lock icon. Key features: - Create notes and checklists anywhere. - Sticky Notes widget, View your note from Home screen - Sync your notes: FlyNote supports sync with Google Drive, so you can access your notes on any device. - Keep your notes safe: Notes lets you protect your notes with a password. - Customize your notes with different themes and backgrounds - Set reminders: FlyNote lets you set reminders for your notes and to-do lists, so you never miss a deadline. - Back up your notes: Notes lets you back up your notes to Google Drive so you never have to worry about losing them. - Recover deleted notes: Notes lets you recover deleted notes from the trash bin. - Create shortcuts: Notes lets you create shortcuts to your notes on your home screen. - Share your notes: FlyNote makes it easy to share your notes with others. From now on, we can share Notes in PDF format with the new PDF feature. Benefits: - Stay organized: FlyNote helps you keep track of your thoughts and ideas in one place. With smart search features, you can easily find the information you need when you need it. - Be productive: Notes can help you be more productive by making it easy to capture and organize your ideas. With its variety of features, you can customize Notes to fit your specific needs. - Be creative: Notes lets you express your creativity in any way you want. FlyNote is the perfect note-taking app for anyone who wants a powerful and versatile tool that can help them stay organized, productive, and creative. With its wide range of features and customization options, Notes is the perfect choice for students, professionals, and anyone else who needs to keep track of their thoughts and ideas.

title: Noteshelf - Notes, Annotations
description:
A new version of Noteshelf is available on the Play Store as a free download. Search for "Noteshelf 3" on the Play Store to find it. We’ll continue to support “Noteshelf 2" (this app). However, if you are a new user, we recommend "Noteshelf 3". It has the latest features to enhance your note-taking experience.

Take beautiful handwritten notes, annotate & markup PDFs, record audio notes, and more with Noteshelf for Android- a note-taking app designed for students, teachers, and professionals to create and organize their digital notes. 

✍️ NATURAL HANDWRITING
- Experience handwriting that feels just right with our range of realistic pens and highlighters. 
- Play around with colors, shapes, and images to create your own notes. So, taking your best class notes or meeting memos is now colorful and fun too! 
- We support a variety of stylus for taking beautiful handwritten notes. You will never miss using a pen and notepad again! On Samsung Galaxy Note devices, we also support a quick-erase option with the S-pen button.

📝 ANNOTATE PDFs & WRITE ON IMAGES
- Import PDFs or images into Noteshelf to highlight, underline, or markup with our convenient formatting tools. 
- You can edit school notes, grade papers, fill out forms, and sign documents too!

🔍 SEARCH & CONVERT HANDWRITTEN NOTES TO TEXT/ OCR
- Search through your notes written in your handwriting. We support handwriting recognition in 65 languages.
- Convert your handwritten notes to typed text seamlessly.

🎁 FIND A TEMPLATE FOR EVERY NEED
- Explore a vast library of 200+ templates created by the Noteshelf team. Find templates for student notes, lesson plans, to-do lists, health trackers, bullet journaling and a lot more.
- Plan and organize your days with a collection of beautiful digital diaries and journals.

🤖NOTESHELF AI
- Introducing Noteshelf AI, an intelligent assistant that can understand your handwriting and help you power through tasks.
- Watch Noteshelf AI generate beautiful handwritten notes on any topic.
- Use Noteshelf AI to create study notes, summarize an entire page of your handwritten notes, translate text, explain complex terms, and more.

📓PERSONALIZE YOUR NOTE-TAKING
- Take notes on lined, dotted, or grid papers in different colors and customizable line spacing.
- Select from packs of beautifully crafted covers to add a personal touch to your notebooks.
- Type your notes and choose from various styles and formatting options.
- Record audio as you take notes so you never miss anything important at school or work. Add as many recordings as you want during lectures and meetings and play them back anytime, even as you take handwritten notes.
- Convert your strokes into perfectly drawn shapes or choose from an array of different shapes to create flowcharts and diagrams.

📚STAY ORGANIZED
- Keep your personal and business notes separate. Drag and drop notebooks into groups or categories quickly to organize them.
- Bookmark important pages, name and color them to create your very own table of contents for your notes.

🗄️KEEP YOUR NOTES SAFE AND ACCESS THEM ANYTIME
- Sync your notes via Google Drive and easily access them on any Android device.
- Auto-backup your notes to Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox or WebDAV
- Automatically publish your notes to Evernote and access them from any location.

➕ SOME MORE FEATURES
- Share your notes as images
- Illustrate your notes with visuals from the UNSPLASH and PIXABAY libraries
Say goodbye to screen glare and embrace a soothing, eye-friendly dark color scheme.

📣Stay tuned for more

Noteshelf is continually evolving, with many exciting features on the way.

Have a suggestion? Reach out to us at noteshelf@fluidtouch.biz. We'd love to hear from you!

Happy note-taking!

“Noteshelf—Digital Note-Taking, Simplified!”

description: MeetGeek is the AI-powered voice recorder app & AI Note Taker that allows you to transcribe speech to text and record audio in over 50 languages for: ✓ face-to-face conversations ✓ online meetings ✓ training courses ✓ interviews & more From today onward, your meetings can end with an accurate transcript & an AI-generated summary in your inbox that includes key highlights, decisions, and action items discussed. Supported languages: Afrikaans, Albanian, Arabic, Armenian, Azerbaijani, Bengali, Bosnian, Bulgarian, Burmese, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Filipino, Finnish, French, Georgian, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Icelandic, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Kazakh, Korean, Latvian, Lithuanian, Macedonian, Malay, Maltese, Mongolian, Nepali, Norwegian, Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Punjabi, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Sundanese, Swahili, Swedish, Tamil, Telugu, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Urdu, Uzbek, Vietnamese, Zulu. MeetGeek Works With the Major Video Calling Apps MeetGeek is a versatile notetaking app for meeting automation that you can use on multiple platforms to help you record audio & get AI-generated summaries. You can easily transcribe speech to text, take notes & summarize meetings conducted on: ✓ Zoom, ✓ Google Meet ✓ Microsoft Teams Record face-to-face conversations MeetGeek is a speech-to-text app that allows you to record audio with just one touch of a button, get voice transcription & a summary of the chat shortly afterward inside the app and via email. This is especially useful if you need to keep records of your business meetings, talks from conferences, or offline meetings with clients. Record & Transcribe speech to text ✓ Record audio & transcribe speech to text for meetings with just one click. ✓ Automatically take meeting notes so you can focus on the conversation. ✓ Have speakers labeled with tags for easy navigation. ✓ Simply invite MeetGeek to meetings on your calendar & you are ready to go Get a Smart AI Summary of Your Meetings ✓ Get a 5-min summary out of a 1-hour meeting. ✓ MeetGeek detects action items, important moments, facts from your meetings & automatically tags them. ✓ Use AI Highlights to quickly review the transcripts of your past conversations. ✓ Send an AI summary over email to other participants of the offline meeting or video call. Highlight & Share Transcripts ✓ Scroll back through the transcript to recall important details. ✓ Share voice, video & text notes with others. ✓ Search past recordings for keywords. ✓ Export transcripts of your conversations as docs. ✓ Integrate with apps like Notion, Slack, ClickUp, Pipedrive, HubSpot, and others. Why Choose MeetGeek? MeetGeek isn't just a voice recorder or a notes app; it's an all-in-one solution designed to enhance your productivity. With MeetGeek, you can effortlessly record audio during any video call & get comprehensive AI summaries, making it easier than ever to keep track of key information & action items. This voice to text app supports over 50 languages & provides 300 minutes of free transcription. Using MeetGeek during your Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams video calls is straightforward. Similarly to Otter AI, Fireflies, Sembly AI, Fathom, Minutes, Transcribe, or Notta, the app provides automatic transcription & note-taking, ensuring you can focus on the discussion rather than worrying about missing important points. The notes app functionality means you can easily organize & review your meeting notes anytime. In addition to its core features, MeetGeek offers detailed & descriptive summaries highlighting key points from your meetings. The app can also transcribe descript face-to-face conversations, making it a versatile tool for various settings. With the MeetGeek AI notetaker, your offline meetings & online video calls become more productive & efficient.

title: Plaud: AI Note Taker
description:
[Product Introduction]

Plaud is building the world's most trusted AI work companion for professionals to elevate productivity and performance through note-taking solutions, trusted by over 1,500,000 users worldwide. With a mission to amplify human intelligence, Plaud is building the next-generation intelligence infrastructure and interfaces to capture, extract, and utilize what you say, hear, see, and think.

Plaud offers a range of AI note-taking devices and solution, each designed to fit different work and life scenarios.
- Plaud Note: The world’s No.1 AI note taker
- Plaud Note Pro: The world’s most advanced AI note taker
- Plaud NotePin / Plaud NotePin S: The world’s most wearable AI note taker
- Plaud Desktop: Capture online meetings natively from the Plaud Desktop App, without a meeting bot.

Whether it’s an in-person meeting, a phone call, an on-the-go conversation, or an online meeting, Plaud keeps you fully present while it handles the notes.


[Plaud Intelligence]

From capturing ideas on Plaud devices to retrieving and applying insights across Plaud App, web, and desktop — Plaud Intelligence is the AI engine behind every experience in the Plaud ecosystem.
- Capture with multimodal input
  - Capture or import audio
  - Press or tap to highlight
  - Input text to add context
  - Enrich context with images
- Extract AI transcripts & contextual summaries
  - AI transcription in 112 languages with speaker labels and custom vocabulary
  - Generate multiple summaries from one conversation automatically, empowered by 10,000+ expert templates
  - Developed on the best LLMs: GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 3 Pro, and more
- Utilize intelligence across your workflow
  - Ask Plaud: Get reference-based answers, generate insights, and save as notes
  - AutoFlow: Automate transcription, summaries, and delivery with set rules
  - Cross-platform sync with unlimited cloud storage.
  - Export, share, and integrate into your workflow
  - Plaud App and Plaud Web: Manage all your notes, summaries, and insights in one place.


[Privacy & Compliance]

Plaud is built with enterprise-grade security and global compliance standards, so your data stays safe, private, and under your control.
- ISO 27001 Compliant: Global standard for information security, keeping your data confidential, intact, and available.
- ISO 27701 Compliant: Global privacy standard, ensures personal data is managed responsibly and transparently.
- GDPR Compliant: Aligns with Europe's strictest privacy regulations
- SOC 2 Compliant: Independently audited systems for security and confidentiality
- HIPAA Compliant: Protects medical and personal health data
- EN 18031 Compliant: Meets European standards for secure wireless communication


[AI Plans]

Starter Plan: Included with any Plaud AI note taker purchase. Enjoy 300 minutes of transcription every month. Comes with access to all Plaud Intelligence features—multimodal input, multidimensional summaries, Ask Plaud, and more.

Pro Plan & Unlimited Plan: Designed for high-demanding or professional use. Pro offers 1,200 minutes per month, while Unlimited removes all time limits.

title: Note AI: Voice AI Transcribe
description:
Note AI: Capture, organize, and revisit every key idea with AI. Note AI provides intelligent recording and efficient organization, helping you clearly and easily capture and review important moments from lectures, meetings, and voice memos.

Still distracted by hurried note-taking? Note AI redefines the recording experience with artificial intelligence, integrating meeting recording, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, content analysis, and AI collaboration. Whether it's a class, a meeting, or a flash of inspiration, all important content is automatically organized into a high-value knowledge base.

🎧Text-to-Speech 
Not only can you "see," you can "hear." Note AI lets you turn notes, summaries, and documents into natural, flowing audio.
-One-click broadcast: Supports direct audio conversion of TXT, PDF, Word, images, scanned documents, and more.
-Personalized listening: Adjust the speed and volume to suit your learning and thinking pace.
-Listen anytime, anywhere: Whether commuting, exercising, doing chores, or reviewing before bed, save time and still learn.

🔊Smart Recording and Transcription
-Continuous background recording: Remains stable even when switching apps or locking the screen, allowing you to focus on the current conversation.
-Speech-to-text: Instantly converts audio into viewable text.
-Long-duration recording: Supports recording lectures up to two hours long and marathon meetings.
-Customizable listening experience: Adjust the speaking speed to match your comprehension rate, or fine-tune the volume for optimal comfort.
-Speaker Recognition: Supports identifying and tracking multiple speakers.
-Auto-capture slides: Click on the transcript to return to the corresponding audio point.
-Share recordings: Share the AI-generated summary of the recorded content with colleagues or classmates with one click.

📝AI Smart Summarization
Upload an audio, PDF, Word, or TXT file, and AI will automatically analyze the content to generate summaries, key points, and to-do lists with one click.
-Summary: Condensate the content to quickly grasp the core information.
-Action Points: Automatically extract to-do items or action suggestions to drive follow-up.
-Key Topics: Summarize key topics and tags. 
- Translation: AI-generated summaries support multi-language translation.

💬 AI Chat Interaction
Communicate with your notes like you're talking to an assistant: Ask questions about uploaded files, and AI will provide accurate answers based on the context.

🎯Who needs Note AI?
▸ Students: Record lectures → Automatically generate review notes with key points
▸ Professionals: Record lengthy meetings → Generate summaries and to-do lists
▸ Content creators: Record interviews and spoken thoughts → Output structured documents with one click
▸ Multitasker: Listen and learn anytime, anywhere → Hands-free, double the efficiency

🚀 Note AI – Capture + Transcribe + Summarize + Listen
From recording to transcription, from summarizing to broadcasting, Note AI is a comprehensive AI assistant that helps you capture every crucial moment, easily organize massive amounts of content, efficiently review, and gain in-depth understanding.
Say goodbye to mechanical note-taking and let AI process information for you, freeing up your brain to focus on truly important creation and thinking.

If you have any questions, please contact us at ainotefeedback@outlook.com. We're always happy to help.

* Terms of Service: https://aichat.emoji-keyboard.com/useragreement.html
* Community Guidelines: https://aichat.emoji-keyboard.com/community-guidelines.html

title: Owll: Al Note Taker Assistant
description:
Meet Owll – your smart AI assistant for seamless AI note-taking
Owll helps you capture every word and idea with powerful voice-to-text and real-time transcription, plus smart AI summaries, an intelligent summarizer, and smart notes from meetings, lectures, webinars, and study sessions.
Record audio, upload files, or save online calls from Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams – then organize, highlight, and share notes with ease.
Use Owll as your reliable meeting recorder or study partner — perfect for work, school, or personal productivity.
Owll AI is also available on the web.
 
Key Features
-AI-Powered Recording, Summaries & To-Dos
Record with one tap using Owll’s AI note taker and built-in AI Coach. Supports voice recorder mode, speech-to-text, voice transcription and audio file imports, then generates concise takeaways and to-do lists so nothing gets missed.
 
-Transcription for Online Meetings
Owll transcribes Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams sessions. Enjoy real-time transcription and clear meeting notes so you can stay focused.
 
-Smart Folders & Note Sharing
Create custom folders to organize recordings and notes. Keep everything tidy, share key takeaways with teammates or classmates in one tap, and manage your library effortlessly for smooth collaboration.
 
-Smarter Note Review: Ask Owll AI
Owll highlights main points, answers questions with built-in AI Q&A — even beyond your notes — and delivers clear summaries from transcripts, recordings, documents, or new topics in seconds.
 
-Versatile Note-Taking & Study Aid
Convert audio into text with precise AI transcription, and let smart summaries turn key points into lecture notes, flashcards, and study cards — ideal as a meeting notes app, productivity tool, or study companion.
 
-Multilingual Transcription & Translation
Owll supports multiple languages with enhanced transcription and translation. Perfect for global meetings, online classes, and cross-team collaboration.
 
-Flashcards & AI-Driven Quizzes
Turn your notes into flashcards and study cards. Owll’s AI quizzes create practice questions to reinforce key ideas and prep for exams.
 
-Import Audio for Seamless Transcription
Import audio from any app or device. Owll supports all formats for smooth speech-to-text. You can also import YouTube videos for transcripts and summaries, or use OCR PDFs to text for scanned material.
 
Boost Your Productivity
Save time with real-time transcriptions, smart summaries, folders, and note sharing.
Reliable Study Companion
Turn spoken content into structured lecture notes, flashcards, and quizzes for easier review and retention.
Hassle-Free Capture
Effortlessly record lectures, talks, and meetings. Owll extracts key takeaways so nothing gets missed.
Global Accessibility
Break language barriers with multilingual transcription and translation.
 
Subscription Plans
 Owll Plus offers these options:
1-Year Subscription
1-Month Subscription
1-Week Subscription
 
Payment & Management
 Payments are billed to your App Store Account upon purchase. Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled 24h before the period ends. Manage subscriptions in Account Settings.
Terms & Privacy
 Terms of Use: https://owll.ai/user-agreement/#/terms-service/
 Privacy Policy: https://owll.ai/user-agreement/#/privacy-policy/

title: Notta-Transcribe Audio to Text
description:
Notta: Your AI-Powered Notetaker for Smarter Workflows
Notta is an intelligent AI notetaking assistant that seamlessly transforms speech into text with outstanding precision and speed. Say goodbye to manual transcription—Notta simplifies the process, helping you effortlessly capture meeting minutes, interview insights, and important AI notes in real time.
Focus on the Conversation, Not the Notes—Let Notta Handle the Rest!

Key Features
- 98.86% transcription accuracy
- AI-powered summarization feature for instant insight
- Supports transcription in 58 languages
- Translate text into 42 languages
- Compatible with various file formats
- AI removes noise and delivers clear, high-quality audio
- Auto-sync across multiple devices
Who is Notta for?
- Salespeople and consultants managing frequent meetings or negotiations
- Remote workers, telecommuters, and those working from home
- Media professionals like journalists, writers, interviewers, and bloggers
- Multilingual speakers or students learning new languages

-Security Certifications

Notta obtained the SOC 2 Type II certification, and received ISO/IEC 27001:2013 certification for its information security management system, reinforcing the reliability and security of our services.

-Real-Time Transcription and Summarization

Start transcription with a single click on your PC, smartphone, or tablet. Notta converts spoken words into text in real-time, letting you focus on the conversation instead of taking notes. The AI summarization feature quickly extracts key points from meetings, lectures, and interviews.

- Integration with Hardware

By pairing with devices like Notta Memo or Zenchord, you can save and summarize audio recordings from various scenarios such as business meetings, interviews, and lectures directly to Notta. Notta Memo can also record audio independently, and once connected to the Notta app later, the recordings are automatically transferred.

-Multiple Transcription Options

Notta supports both live transcription and automatic transcription of pre-recorded files. Import audio or video files, and get a one-hour recording transcribed in about five minutes.

-Streamlined Editing Experience

Add bookmarks during transcription to mark important statements, making post-meeting edits faster and more efficient. Searching through recordings is effortless—simply enter keywords to locate specific segments.

-Easily Share Transcription Data

Save transcribed text in formats such as txt, docx, excel, pdf, or srt (subtitles). Export transcriptions with recorded timestamps and timelines, or share them via a link with colleagues and friends.

Capture anything, anytime and convert into intelligent notes with AI.
Audio, Videos, Photos, YouTube, PDFs, Web Links, and more, NotterAI handles it all.

Your All-in-One Offline AI Note-Taking App

NotterAI is your intelligent assistant that turns meetings, lectures, videos, and documents into organized, searchable notes instantly. With custom note templates, you decide how your notes are structured using headings, bullets, checklists, or summaries.

Whether you’re recording a meeting, analyzing a PDF, or summarizing a YouTube video, NotterAI lets you focus on learning, creating, or leading while AI handles your notes.

Record anywhere, even without internet. Your files are saved locally and summarized automatically once you reconnect.

KEY FEATURES
• Real-Time Notes from Anything
• Automatic speaker identification
• Instant meeting summaries with action items
• Record meetings, lectures, and voice notes offline

Custom Note Templates
• Create your own note templates
• Control how sections are structured
• Use summaries, bullets, or checklists
• Start with 8+ preset styles or design your own

Multi-Format Input Support
• Audio recordings & voice memos (offline supported)
• YouTube videos (paste URL, get notes)
• PDF documents & research papers

• Web articles & blog posts
• Text documents & emails

AI-Powered Intelligence
• Smart summarization that captures key points
• Automatic topic extraction & organization
• Searchable note database
• Custom summary lengths & styles
• Export to multiple formats

PERFECT FOR EVERY NEED
• Students: Record lectures Offline, summarize textbooks, and turn YouTube tutorials into study guides.

• Researchers: Analyze academic papers, transcribe interviews, and organize findings 10x faster.
• Content Creators: Summarize trending videos, research competitors, and collect insights.

WHY CHOOSE NotterAI
• Offline ready, record and save notes without internet
• Fully personalized with custom note templates
• Lightning fast processing for long content
• High accuracy AI transcription and summarization
• Private by design with encrypted data
• Cross platform support with cloud sync
• Constant improvements with regular updates

EXPERIENCE THE FUTURE OF NOTE TAKING
Download NotterAI today and simplify how you capture ideas.
Record offline. Summarize instantly. Customize your notes.

Your recordings and transcripts remain private.
Files are stored securely on your device until you choose to sync or summarize.

title: AI Transcribe Audio to Text
description:
Transcribe audio to text effortlessly with Stenote AI Notetaker, the most accurate AI note taker and speech-to-text app. Record and transcribe meetings, lectures, and conversations into AI-generated summaries, meeting minutes, and detailed notes.

An easy AI Speech To Text app for transcribing speech of any length, from just a few seconds to many hours long. Using the latest speech to text AI models, Stenote will transcribe speech and create a summary, smart chapters, meeting minutes and meeting notes automatically in a few seconds.

Transcribe audio, video and YouTube to text in realtime or upload an audio file with AI. Transcribe podcasts, lectures, work meetings, school events or virtual meetings. Dial in to Google Meet, Teams or Zoom with Stenote.

Listen back to your recorded audio and follow the audio transcript word for word as it highlights each section with human levels of accuracy.

Download your transcript or summary in PDF, Plain Text, SRT, VTT or JSON. Allowing you to import it into most applications or share the recorded audio as an MP3.

Super simple user interface. Just hit the big record button and watch it transcribe audio. Then save your recordings to your library to review later, with no annoying pop ups, ads or interruptions.

I’m an indie app developer, so listen to all your feedback. Email me and I will respond to any queries and or add any features upon request!

Turn your audio into something useful with Stenote, and stop focusing on capturing notes and free your mind up so you can be part of the conversation.

Concise, well written summaries of your meetings, identify who’s speaking and generate actionable insights and takeaways automatically and share them with your colleagues.

Stenote is great for business meetings, school, university lectures, doctors appointments or anything where you need to stay engaged but still capture what happened.

For students

Record and transcribe classes and lectures with clear quality, even when the teacher is not right in front of you. Listen and follow along to these recordings as many times as you want to help you study for that next exam. Speed up or slow down playback to listen at a comfortable pace.

With no time limits and the option to choose a compressed format, it's easy to record the longest classes and lectures.

For business

Capture interviews and meetings from your phone or tablet, generate notes and an audio transcript then share them with your colleagues through email or your favorite messaging app.

No ads and no subscription required.

Every day, 60,000+ thoughts flash through your mind, most vanishing instantly... 
Every day, you're bombarded with 1 billion bits of visual information. Information anxiety is real. We all have the same 24 hours—why do some people create so much more value?

title: TwinMind - AI Notes & Memory
description:
TwinMind captures everything you say and hear in your meetings, lectures, and in-person conversations. It automatically transcribes, summarizes, proactively offers suggestions and tasks, and continuously builds context for your AI Second Brain.

TwinMind is a productivity tool leveraging AI to function as your second brain. It captures everything heard, seen, and said—growing with you the more you interact and engage with TwinMind to build a comprehensive context of your digital life. This captured context enables several key features:

Personalized and Proactive Assistance: TwinMind provides tailored suggestions and ideas based on your captured memories, anticipating needs and offering relevant insights.

Streamlined Productivity: It enhances your notetaking by having your AI assistant automate tasks such as generating summaries and action items from meetings and conversations. You can search their entire memory bank, ask questions, generate emails and study guides, investor memos, project plans, and more.

Privacy Focus: TwinMind prioritizes user privacy through on-device transcription, options to save transcripts locally or on the cloud. We’re committed to zero third-party data sharing. Audio is processed on-the-fly and never stored. 

Key Features and Functionality:

- Capture and Context Building: Captures your activity (audio, visual, text) on mobile and desktop if partnered with the TwinMind chrome extension.
- Personalized Suggestions: Your AI sidekick will offer tailored insights based on captured memories.
- Automated Summaries and Action Items: Extracts key information from meetings, conversations, and class lectures.
- Searchable Memory Bank: Allows you to search your captured history and notes.
- Ask TwinMind Anything: Enables you to ask questions and receive answers with context of your memories or active meetings.
- Content Generation: Facilitates the creation of follow up emails, study guides, and other documents to help increase your productivity.
- Privacy Protection: Employs on-device transcription, choice to switch to private mode to store transcriptions locally, and no third-party data sharing.

TwinMind aims to boost your productivity by providing a centralized, AI-powered platform that captures, organizes, and leverages your captured memories to offer personalized assistance and automate tasks, all while safeguarding your privacy.

TwinMind offers auto-renewable subscription(s):
  - TwinMind Pro (Monthly) (1 Month) - $15.00
  - TwinMind Pro (Annually) (1 Year) - $ 119.99
  - Subscription automatically renews unless it’s canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 

Terms of Service:  https://twinmind.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://twinmind.com/privacy-policy/

title: Audionotes: AI Notes & Minutes

🎙️ VOICE MEMO TO TEXT — INSTANTLY
Hit record or upload any audio file. Audionotes transcribes your voice memos with exceptional accuracy in 99+ languages. No more typing — just talk, and your words become searchable, shareable notes.

Stop scrambling to take notes during meetings. Audionotes records every word, generates detailed meeting minutes, and extracts action items automatically. Your meeting notes are organized, accurate, and ready to share — without lifting a pen.

Perfect for:
• Team meetings & standups
• Client calls & sales meetings
• Board meetings & strategy sessions
• 1:1s and interviews

Students love Audionotes. Record lectures and get AI-generated:
• Complete lecture transcriptions
• Summarized lecture notes with key concepts
• Mind maps for visual learning
• Flashcards for active recall study
• Quizzes to test your understanding

Upload YouTube lectures and get study notes in seconds. Never miss an important point in class again.

title: AI Note Taker - NotebookAI
description:
AI Note Taker for Meetings, Lectures and More!

NoteNinja is your personal AI note taker, designed to capture, organize, and transform your notes effortlessly. Whether you’re in a meeting, attending a lecture this AI-powered tool makes note-taking smarter and more efficient by converting any audio, or media into structured notes, flashcards, quizzes, and more.

Key Features:

-Capture: Let the AI note taker automatically summarize key points from meetings, lectures, or any audio input. Forget about manual note-taking!
-Organize: Keep your notes structured and categorized by topic, date, or priority, making navigation quick and simple with your AI note taker.
-Summarize: Get concise summaries instantly from long meetings, lectures etc.. The AI note taker quickly distills the key points for you.
-Media Integration: Upload audio and let the AI note taker do the work of summarizing and organizing content from various sources.
-Interactive Learning: Use the AI note taker to create quizzes and flashcards based on your notes for deeper engagement and easier learning.

Use Cases:

-Meetings: The AI note taker captures all the important action points, decisions, and details from your meetings, allowing you to convert discussions into organized summaries or to-do lists.
-Lectures: Students can rely on the AI note taker to summarize key lecture points and organize class notes for more efficient studying.
-Personal Use: Organize your to-do lists, daily tasks, or personal thoughts with ease using the AI note taker’s advanced note-taking features.

Additional Benefits:

-Boost Productivity: Stay focused on what’s important while the AI note taker captures and organizes notes in real time.
-Customization: Edit your notes and transcribed content as needed, and tailor them with reminders, tags, or custom sections.
-Interactive Learning Tools: Create quizzes and flashcards directly from your notes using the AI note taker for more interactive and engaging learning.
-Multilingual Support: Take notes in over 100 languages with the AI note taker, making it an excellent tool for global use.
-Centralized Hub: Access all your notes in one place, with a clear and organized overview of your note-taking history.

NoteNinja requires premium subscription in order to use ai note taking features. Please purchase our yearly plan for $39.99 per year or $6.99 per week.

title: Rosebud: AI Journal & Diary
description:
Rosebud is your personal AI-powered self care companion. Rosebud is a therapist-recommended journaling and self-reflection tool designed to support your personal growth and emotional wellness. Rosebud is a diary that evolves with you, learning from your entries and providing personalized prompts, feedback, and insights tailored for your growth.

THE BEST DAILY JOURNALING APP

Navigating challenging emotions? Want to better manage stress, anxiety, or overthinking? Rosebud is designed to help you work through difficult emotions and thoughts through structured self-reflection. Whether you prefer to write or speak your thoughts, with just a few minutes of voice or text journaling, you'll reduce stress and gain clarity.

REVIEWS

Our users tell us:

"I absolutely love it. I never thought I would have done AI journaling. I love the prompts and the insights into my personality are amazing and literally help me succeed in life." ~ Cameron T.

"I love this app. It's helped me replace doom scrolling while integrating more self reflection and mindfulness throughout my day. The prompts are well thought out, and I've seen an improvement in my mood and self awareness. Highly recommend." ~ Vesna M.

"This is turbocharging my journaling habit. Self-reflection x collaborative brainstorming x empathetic feedback = GAME CHANGER!" ~ Chris G.

"It feels like daily 'brain hygiene' to use this app, dump out my thoughts and force myself to think through things in a way I might normally avoid." ~ Erica R.

"It's like having my own personal coach right in my left pocket. The long-term memory helps me see my thinking traps, patterns, and reframe negative emotions. " ~ Alicia L.

FEATURES FOR DAILY SELF IMPROVEMENT

Reflect & Process
• Interactive Daily Diary: Interactive self-reflection with real-time guidance for text and voice entries
• Expert-Crafted Experiences: Guided journals using evidence-based self-reflection frameworks (eg. CBT techniques, gratitude practice, etc.)
• Voice Journaling: Express yourself naturally in 20 languages using our advanced transcription or voice mode

Learn & Grow
• Intelligent Pattern Recognition: AI learns about you and recognizes patterns across entries
• Smart Mood Tracker: AI helps you understand emotional patterns and triggers

Track Progress
• Smart Goal Tracker: AI habit and goal suggestions and accountability
• Daily Quotes: Affirmations, haikus, proverbs tailored to you based on your entries
• Weekly Personal Growth Insights: Track themes, progress, wins, emotional landscape, and more with comprehensive weekly analysis provided by AI

PRIVACY FIRST

Your thoughts are personal. Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest to keep your data completely secure. 

Plus, secure your journal with biometric locking using Face ID, Touch ID, or a personal PIN code for an extra layer of protection.

We're on a mission to build a future where everyone has the power to live happier, more fulfilled lives. Rosebud is constantly updated with the latest in psychology and AI technology to provide you with the best self-reflection and personal growth support. 

Rosebud is a personal growth and wellness tool designed to support self-reflection and goal achievement. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition, nor is it a substitute for professional mental health care, medical advice, or therapy.

If you're experiencing a mental health crisis, please contact emergency services or a crisis hotline immediately.

Join thousands of happy Rosebud users today! Your future self awaits.

title: Standard Notes
description:
Standard Notes is a secure and private notes app. It syncs your notes securely across all your devices, including your Android devices, Windows, iOS, Linux, and Web.

Private means your notes are end-to-end encrypted, so only you can read your notes. Even we can't read the contents of your notes.

Simple means it does one job and does it well. Standard Notes is a safe and lasting place for your life's work. Our focus is making it easy to write notes wherever you are and syncing them with encryption to all your devices.

Our users love us for:
• Personal Notes
• Tasks & Todos
• Passwords & Keys
• Code & Technical Procedures
• Private Journal
• Meeting Notes
• Cross-platform Scratchpad
• Books, Recipes, & Movies
• Health & Fitness Log

Standard Notes comes free with:
• Seamless sync across all your devices, with easy to use applications on Android, Windows, Linux, iPhone, iPad, Mac, and web browsers.
• Offline access, so you can access your downloaded notes even without a connection.
• No limit on number of devices.
• No limit on number of notes.
• Passcode lock protection, along with fingerprint protection.
• A tagging system to organize your notes (like #work, #ideas, #passwords, #crypto).
• The ability to pin, lock, protect, and move notes to trash, which allows you to recover deleted notes until the trash is emptied.

Standard Notes is completely open-source, which means when we say your notes are encrypted with industry-leading XChaCha-20 encryption, and that only you can read your notes, you don't have to take our word for it. Our code is open to the world to audit.

We made Standard Notes simple because longevity is important to us. We want to make sure we're here, protecting your notes, for the next hundred years. You shouldn't have to find a new notes app every year.

To sustain our development, we offer an optional paid program called Standard Notes Extended. Extended gives you access to powerful tools including:
• Productivity editors (like Markdown, Code, Spreadsheets)
• Beautiful themes (like Midnight, Focus, Solarized Dark)
• Powerful cloud tools including daily backups of your encrypted data delivered to your email inbox every day, or backed up to your cloud provider (like Dropbox and Google Drive).

You can learn more about Extended at standardnotes.com/extended.

We're always happy to talk, whether it be a question, thought, or issue. Please feel free to email us any time at help@standardnotes.com. When you take the time to send us a message, we'll be sure to do the same.
